No cubic homological denominator vanishes for theta in (0,pi/3), permitting an analytic odd near-identity transform to u-prime=omega u[1+(-a_alpha+i a_alpha c)|u|^2+O(|u|^4)]. Local radial contraction implies rho(n)^-1=2a_alpha n+O(log n). Angular increments theta+a_alpha c rho(n)+O(rho(n)^2) have an absolutely summable error relative to theta+(c/2)/n, proving a finite phase constant and stated error. Irrational theta uses Weyl partial summation; rational theta uses unbounded monotone tau log(qj+r) with vanishing steps. Both give the entire ellipse. The exact executable identity, resonant coefficient and finite trajectory diagnostics passed after extraction.
